stem: Which of the following statements about the treatment of physeal arrest is correct?

options.text: Once partially arrested, the rest of the growth plate will become necrotic and growth will cease
Interposition with bone graft is desirable
Removal of a bar will cause full growth to resume, sometimes with catch up growth
Growth can be restored if small physeal bars are removed

explanation: Small physeal bars may be resected to restore some growth if the remaining physis is viable. Larger bars or widespread arrest are less suitable for bar resection.
rationale: The best answer is D because limited physeal bar resection can sometimes restore longitudinal growth when the arrest is small and the remaining physis is functional.

optionExplanations.A: Partial physeal arrest does not necessarily mean the entire growth plate becomes necrotic.
optionExplanations.B: Bone graft interposition is not the standard desirable treatment for physeal bar resection.
optionExplanations.C: Bar removal may improve growth, but full growth resumption with catch-up growth is not guaranteed.
optionExplanations.D: This is correct: resection of a small physeal bar can restore growth in selected cases.
optionExplanations.E: One of the listed statements is correct, so this is not the best answer.
